snippet.title: Color Story: Pixa's Quest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Color Story: Pixa's Quest is a platform game I'm currently developing. The demo is currently on steam and takes most players 30-60 minutes to complete. Try it out and let me know your thoughts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023530/Color_Story_Pixas_Quest/
